name: Ina (Saitama, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ina town emblem in red: an outlined ring surrounded by stylised petals, like a flower.
history: Municipal flag of Ina, a town in Saitama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 November 1970.

features.role: Ina town emblem — an outlined ring surrounded by stylised petals, like a flower
